verdict.rationale: Grok Business documents some workspace administration: email invitations for new members, SSO integration with an identity provider, sharing limited to licensed team members, and 'enterprise-grade privacy protections' under business plan terms. Role/permission management and configurable data policies are not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: role/permission assignment controls, member removal or deprovisioning, admin-configurable data retention/training policies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
